trustedTenant: query.tenantId must equal TenantContextHolder.getRequiredTenantId before Owner access; no tenant switching

fact.source: one tenant-scoped ProjectMasterDO row from proj_project
fact.customerSemantics: customerCode/customerName are the project occurrence snapshot and share projectVersion; they are not CUS current-master or service-level truth
fact.departmentSemantics: departmentId/departmentCode/departmentName are the project occurrence snapshot from the same row and are displayed by CUT as the office context; the public DTO does not introduce officeCode aliases and CUT does not resolve SYSTEM current organization for this snapshot

resultUnion.FOUND: currentFact is complete and decision is FOUND
resultUnion.VERSION_CONFLICT: lockAndRevalidate only; currentFact is the complete current fact

revalidation.match: same tenantId/projectId, ACTIVE lifecycle, complete fact and row.version equals expectedProjectVersion returns FOUND
revalidation.versionMismatch: return VERSION_CONFLICT with current complete non-sensitive fact; no business write
revalidation.inactive: return INACTIVE for lifecycle other than ACTIVE
revalidation.ownerCorruption: throw OWNER_DATA_CORRUPTED; never return a partial FOUND

consumerMapping.scope: CUT separately uses ProjectScopeApi PROJECT_VIEW/PROJECT_EDIT and treeVersion; projectVersion never substitutes for scopeVersion
consumerMapping.resolveCreateContext: FOUND supplies project and department occurrence facts plus trusted customerId/code/name; CUT maps department to the office display and then calls CustomerServiceLevelFactApi by customerId
consumerMapping.createAndSubmit: CUT passes the previously displayed projectVersion to lockAndRevalidate and freezes the returned exact fact

forbidden: CUT reads proj_project or SYSTEM/CUS tables
CUT combines ProjectScopeResult, ProjectOrganizationFact and CustomerSummaryDTO into an unversioned fact
client supplies customer or office identity
project customer snapshot is presented as current CUS master truth
